ask: GitHub Actions. .github/workflows/ci.yml: CI for a Python+Node repo — matrix on 3.11/3.12, dependency caching, lint job with ruff, type check job with mypy, test job with coverage upload, build artifacts, and a final gate job that depends on all. write the file.

files..github/workflows/ci.yml:
name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: ["main", "master"]
  pull_request:
    branches: ["main", "master"]

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  # ── Lint (ruff) ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  lint:
    name: Lint (ruff)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        python-version: ["3.11", "3.12"]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}

      - name: Cache pip
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cache/pip
          key: pip-lint-${{ matrix.python-version }}-${{ hashFiles('**/requirements*.txt', '**/pyproject.toml') }}
          restore-keys: |
            pip-lint-${{ matrix.python-version }}-

      - name: Install lint dependencies
        run: pip install ruff

      - name: Run ruff
        run: ruff check . --output-format=github

  # ── Type check (mypy) ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  typecheck:
    name: Type check (mypy)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        python-version: ["3.11", "3.12"]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}

      - name: Cache pip
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cache/pip
          key: pip-typecheck-${{ matrix.python-version }}-${{ hashFiles('**/requirements*.txt', '**/pyproject.toml') }}
          restore-keys: |
            pip-typecheck-${{ matrix.python-version }}-

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install mypy
          # Install project deps so mypy can resolve imports
          if [ -f requirements.txt ]; then pip install -r requirements.txt; fi
          if [ -f pyproject.toml ]; then pip install -e ".[dev]" 2>/dev/null || pip install -e . 2>/dev/null || true; fi

      - name: Run mypy
        run: mypy .

  # ── Tests with coverage ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  test:
    name: Test (Python ${{ matrix.python-version }})
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        python-version: ["3.11", "3.12"]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}

      - name: Set up Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: lts/*
          cache: npm

      - name: Cache pip
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cache/pip
          key: pip-test-${{ matrix.python-version }}-${{ hashFiles('**/requirements*.txt', '**/pyproject.toml') }}
          restore-keys: |
            pip-test-${{ matrix.python-version }}-

      - name: Install Python dependencies
        run: |
          pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install pytest pytest-cov coverage[toml]
          if [ -f requirements.txt ]; then pip install -r requirements.txt; fi
          if [ -f pyproject.toml ]; then pip install -e ".[dev]" 2>/dev/null || pip install -e . 2>/dev/null || true; fi

      - name: Install Node dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Run Python tests with coverage
        run: |
          pytest \
            --cov \
            --cov-report=xml:coverage-${{ matrix.python-version }}.xml \
            --cov-report=term-missing \
            -v

      - name: Run Node tests
        run: npm test

      - name: Upload coverage report
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: coverage-${{ matrix.python-version }}
          path: coverage-${{ matrix.python-version }}.xml
          retention-days: 7

  # ── Build artifacts ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  build:
    name: Build artifacts
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [lint, typecheck, test]
    strategy:
      matrix:
        python-version: ["3.11", "3.12"]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}

      - name: Set up Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: lts/*
          cache: npm

      - name: Cache pip
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cache/pip
          key: pip-build-${{ matrix.python-version }}-${{ hashFiles('**/requirements*.txt', '**/pyproject.toml') }}
          restore-keys: |
            pip-build-${{ matrix.python-version }}-

      - name: Install Python build deps
        run: |
          pip install --upgrade pip build
          if [ -f requirements.txt ]; then pip install -r requirements.txt; fi

      - name: Install Node dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Build Python package
        run: python -m build

      - name: Build Node package
        run: npm run build --if-present

      - name: Upload Python dist
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: python-dist-${{ matrix.python-version }}
          path: dist/
          retention-days: 7

      - name: Upload Node dist
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: node-dist-${{ matrix.python-version }}
          path: |
            dist/
            build/
          retention-days: 7

  # ── Gate ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  gate:
    name: CI gate
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [lint, typecheck, test, build]
    if: always()
    steps:
      - name: Check all jobs passed
        run: |
          results='${{ toJSON(needs) }}'
          echo "$results"
          if echo "$results" | grep -q '"result": "failure"'; then
            echo "One or more required jobs failed."
            exit 1
          fi
          if echo "$results" | grep -q '"result": "cancelled"'; then
            echo "One or more required jobs were cancelled."
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "All required jobs passed."

prose:
The file wrote successfully. A few things worth noting about the workflow:

**Gate job** uses `if: always()` with a grep-based check rather than `needs` alone — this ensures it fails explicitly when any upstream job is cancelled, not just failed.

**Caching** is keyed on both `requirements*.txt` and `pyproject.toml` hashes, so the cache invalidates correctly regardless of which file you use to declare deps.

**Node setup** is included in `test` and `build` jobs but not `lint`/`typecheck` — adjust if your Python type stubs depend on generated Node output.

**Coverage upload** produces separate artifacts per Python version (`coverage-3.11.xml`, `coverage-3.12.xml`). If you want Codecov or similar, add a step like:

```yaml
- name: Upload to Codecov
  uses: codecov/codecov-action@v4
  with:
    files: coverage-${{ matrix.python-version }}.xml
    flags: python-${{ matrix.python-version }}
```

One thing to verify: the `npm test` and `npm run build` commands assume those scripts exist in your `package.json`. If they're named differently, adjust those lines.
